title: 远景科技Ricky Jung：融资利率更友好，芯片由客户主导？
speaker: Ricky Jung

segments.en: At what interest rate and cost, though, I think is, and Rick, I mean, what are you seeing? Are our, you know, providers of capital having to demanding higher interest rates to provide that financing?
segments.zh: 但利率和成本是多少，Rick，你怎么看？资金提供方是否要求更高利率来提供融资？

segments.en: And I wonder effectively what we're seeing elsewhere in the world is happening also in China, or could it be the opposite?
segments.zh: 我想知道，全球其他地方的情况是否也在中国发生，或者相反？

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah. So for the kind of, this is actually the whole government and our local community are really supportive to that.
segments.zh: 是的，是的。实际上整个政府和当地社区都非常支持。

segments.en: So which means that we can just get in the money with a very fair interest rate, not higher than the normal one.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们可以以非常公平的利率获得资金，不高于正常水平。

segments.en: And sometimes you can get even lower for the longer terms. So all of the society and the government is really supportive for these constructions and developments.
segments.zh: 有时长期利率甚至更低。整个社会和政府都非常支持这些建设和开发。

segments.en: So and as I mentioned that once you get the very promising off-take agreement, you can get even lower for the cost of money.
segments.zh: 正如我提到的，一旦获得非常有前景的承购协议，资金成本甚至可以更低。

segments.en: Ricky, what about when it comes to chips? How do you ensure that you get powerful enough chips for Oolankov and who are your biggest providers right now?
segments.zh: Ricky，芯片方面呢？你如何确保为Oolankov获得足够强大的芯片，目前最大的供应商是谁？

segments.en: Yeah, so far actually we're more about the co-location. So we build the power and the data center infrastructure.
segments.zh: 是的，到目前为止我们更多是做共同选址。我们建设电力和数据中心基础设施。

segments.en: The chips are more living to our off-take, our clients. They are mostly like looking for that.
segments.zh: 芯片更多是交给我们的承购客户。他们大多在寻找这个。

segments.en: So, but we will also coordinate with them on how to better leverage their or fully leverage their chips or the computing power they get by trying to maximize our power advantage and providing enough power to their chips.
segments.zh: 但我们也会与他们协调，如何更好地利用或充分利用他们的芯片或算力，通过最大化我们的电力优势并为他们的芯片提供足够电力。

segments.en: But for the chips, we don't have too much information on that.
segments.zh: 但关于芯片，我们掌握的信息不多。
